newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan temperatures average to high for Feb 8-Mar 7.
newsitem.headline: Japan temperatures average to high for Feb 8-Mar 7.

text.p: Temperatures are forecast to be average or higher than average between February 8 and March 7, the Meteorological Agency said on Friday.
It said it expected temperatures to be higher than usual at this time of the year in northern and eastern Japan, and about average in western Japan.
Islands in the southwestern part of the country are expected to see about average temperatures and heavy rainfall.
Rainfall is likely to be about average in other parts of the country, it said.
Less than average sunshine for the time of year is expected in southwestern islands, and average in other parts of the country, the agency said.
